svg.title: ARGO AI
svg.desc: ARGO AI logo for dark backgrounds: Aaron's master logo (white background version, received Nov 24, 2026) converted for dark surfaces — the ARGO letters recolored white, the outline gradient glyph, the teal sail in the A, and the gradient AI keep their original colors. Embedded raster of the original artwork; replace with the master vector file if one becomes available.
